sara (AE): Hey team — Nimbus Thera sent their RFI this morning. Main asks: POC timeline, dedicated capacity pricing tiers, and answers for sections 3.1/4.2 (data residency + KMS). Can we sync on responses?
raj (SE): I can handle the POC runbook and perf targets. Need to confirm target qps and max latency SLO. Any customer targets?
elaine (AE): They put initial traffic estimate at 250 qps peak during evaluation, 3ms target p95 for embeddings is unrealistic, they wrote 300ms in the doc. I'll push back on p95 wording.
tom (Solution Eng): For 250 qps we should recommend Dedicated with autoscale + burst. Quick calc: 2x A100 equivalent for stable 250 qps gen workloads. I’ll add cost ranges.
sara (AE): Good. Also they flagged FedRAMP-ish controls; asked about HSM and customer-managed KMS. Maria, can we confirm Private offering compatibility with HSM key wrapping?
maria (Security Eng): Yes — Private supports customer KMS via Cloud KMS or HSM over KMIP. For hosted we offer envelope encryption with BYOK via partner HSMs (see note). I’ll paste a short answer we can copy into the RFI: 
```
Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Private deployments via KMIP-compatible HSMs and cloud KMS integrations. Audit logs and key access controls are available; hosted API supports envelope encryption with partner HSMs for Bring-Your-Own-Key scenarios.
```
elaine (AE): Perfect. Need a crisp capability matrix row for "Key management / HSM" and "Data residency" — one-liners.
raj (SE): Draft rows: 
- Key management / HSM: "BYOK via KMIP, cloud KMS integrations, audit logs"
- Data residency: "Deployments in NA/EU regions; Private VPC options for on-prem or customer colocation"
I’ll attach perf notes.
sara (AE): Pricing Q: they asked for monthly committed capacity price and an overage rate. We have standard tiers but we can give a tailored quote for POC. Tom, can you propose ranges and a POC discount?
tom (Solution Eng): Proposed: POC reserved (1 month) = estimated $24k-$36k based on 2x A100 equivalent; overage on hosted burst = $0.15/token-gen equivalent. Recommend 20% POC discount and success milestone for extended pilot.
sara (AE): Nice. Add a line about rollbacks/fallbacks in the RFI: if Dedicated node unavailable, auto-failover to compatible model in hosted fleet.
maria (Security Eng): Also include SOC2/ISO attestations and our standard penetration testing cadence. Copyable line: "SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 attestations available on request; annual third-party pentests and continuous vuln scanning."
raj (SE): Attaching quick sample commands for their infra team to validate connectivity during POC: 
```
# Run basic healthcheck to our ingress (example)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
# Verify TLS ciphers
openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443 -cipher 'ECDHE' -showcerts
```
elaine (AE): Can someone drop the shared Drive link to the RFI docs and the capability matrix spreadsheet? I’ll populate commercial terms.
sara (AE): Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/nimbus-rfi/ (notes + attachments). I added a "Pending" column for legal & security review.
tom (Solution Eng): I updated the capability matrix with rows for latency, throughput, model rollouts, quantization options, and observability hooks. Small note: Quantization support: INT8/4-bit on Dedicated via our optimized runtime.
maria (Security Eng): I’ll review the privacy/security section tonight. Please flag any claims that mention "FedRAMP" specifically — we can describe controls but not claim accreditation unless legal confirms.
elain (AE): typo — should be "elaine".
sara (AE): Haha, noted.
raj (SE): Quick follow-up: Are there customer-provided dataset onboarding constraints? Nimbus asked about ephemeral data handling during eval. Our standard is ephemeral KV caching with retention = 0 by default unless customer opts in.
maria (Security Eng): Correct. Data in flight encrypted; KV cache TTL is configurable and we support automatic eviction and scrub on POC termination. Add that to the answer bank.
sara (AE): Ok action items: raj = runbook + perf rows; tom = pricing ranges + capability matrix edits; maria = security copy + KMS language; elaine = commercial terms in Drive. I’ll assemble final RFI by EOD and ping legal.
rfi-bot: reminder: RFI template v3 created and assigned to sara (AE) — due 2026-03-27.
sara (AE): Thanks all :thumbsup: I’ll post the compiled responses here when ready.
